name: 皮肤微运动分析
algorithm: Skin Micro Motion — Sensor/Physical Model Analyzer
mechanism:
This method analyzes skin micro-motion for deepfake detection:

1. **Micro-运动Amplification**: Subtle skin surface movements are amplified using Eulerian video magnification or phase-based motion amplification. This reveals sub-pixel movements invisible to direct observation — physiological signals encoded in skin surface dynamics.

2. **PulseWave检测**: The cardiac pulse produces a wave of skin displacement traveling from the heart through arterial branches. This pulse wave should be detectable on the face (particularly at the temporal artery region, neck, and forehead). The method checks for pulse wave presence and propagation consistency. Deepfakes lack physiological micro-motion.

3. **Respiratory运动信号**: Chest and shoulder respiratory motion may produce subtle cascading movements visible on the neck and lower face. The method detects respiratory-frequency micro-motion in appropriate facial regions. Absence of respiratory micro-motion indicates AI generation.

4. **Micro-运动空间相干性**: Physiological micro-motion should be spatially coherent — neighboring skin regions show correlated micro-motion from the same underlying physiological source. The method checks spatial coherence of detected micro-motion. AI generation may produce spatially incoherent micro-motion (independent noise per pixel/region).

5. **Micro-运动频率频谱**: Natural skin micro-motion has characteristic frequency content: cardiac (1-2 Hz), respiratory (0.2-0.33 Hz), and physiological tremor (8-12 Hz). The method analyzes the frequency spectrum of amplified motion. AI-generated micro-motion may lack these characteristic frequency components or show wrong frequency signatures.
parameters:
分析类型: sensor
媒体: 视频
输入: Video frames extracted at key intervals
输出: 置信度分数 (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: 中到高 — 70-88% 独立准确率. Most effective when combined with other 视频 forensic methods. Performance depends on 视频 quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detection of deepfake and AI-generated 视频 through skin micro motion analysis. This method examines temporal and spatial features that are difficult for AI systems to perfectly replicate, providing evidence for 视频 authenticity assessment.
strengths:
• Captures temporal artifacts that single-frame analysis misses
• Works with standard 视频 formats
• Effective against common deepfake techniques
• Can be combined with other 视频 forensic methods
• Based on established computer vision research
limitations:
• Performance affected by 视频 compression and resolution
• Some methods require sufficient frame count for temporal analysis
• Effectiveness varies with deepfake generation technique
• Best used as part of a comprehensive multi-method pipeline
• May produce false positives on heavily edited authentic 视频
